question: Who is serving as the 34th Foreign Secretary of India from 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vinay Mohan Kwatra.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vinay Mohan Kwatra** is serving as the** 34th Foreign Secretary of India** from **2022.**
 
• Vinay Mohan Kwatra is a **1988-batch Indian Foreign Service officer** who has held several key positions in the **Ministry of External Affairs,** including as **India's Ambassador to France** and Monaco and **India's High Commissioner** to Sri Lanka.
 
• The **chief administrative officer** of the **Ministry of External Affairs** and **India's top diplomat** is the** Foreign Secretary.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Subrahmanyam Jaishankar **was the **33rd Foreign Secretary of India** who served from **January 2015 to January 2018**.

 
 
• He is currently serving as **India's Minister of External Affairs.**
 
• **Vijay Keshav Gokhale** was the 31st Foreign Secretary of India who served from January 2018 to January 2020.

 He has previously served as India's Ambassador to China and as India's High Commissioner to Malaysia.
 
 
 
• **Harsh Vardhan Shringla** was the **33rd Foreign Secretary of India** who served from **January 2020 to January 2022.**
 
 
• He is currently serving as** India's Ambassador** to the United States.
 
 
 
• The role of the Foreign Secretary of India is to act as the administrative head of the **Ministry of External Affairs **and to advise the Prime Minister and other Ministers on matters of foreign policy.
 
 
• The Foreign Secretary also represents** India in international forums** and negotiates with foreign governments on behalf of the Indian government.
